summary: Backend API testing complete. 13/13 pytest cases pass (100% backend). Validated: auth login (citizen & admin + invalid), new POST /api/register-push endpoint (no-auth, validation, graceful failure with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY returning 500 as expected per spec), Reports CRUD (create as citizen, list scoping for citizen vs admin, single GET, persistence after update), role-based access (citizen blocked from PUT and stats), admin status update with non-blocking push notification (push fails upstream with 401 but PUT still returns 200 - confirmed in backend logs), and stats endpoint. Mocked: EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY placeholder causes upstream 401 to /api/v1/push/users/register and /api/v1/push/trigger - handled gracefully without crashing the server.

minor.issue: When EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is placeholder, returns 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' rather than the graceful 200 {status:failed} fallback. The except HTTPException re-raise prevents reaching the graceful handler. Acceptable per playbook but consider catching upstream-key failures gracefully so client registration never errors. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:237-248
ReportUpdate.admin_notes uses 'if update_data.admin_notes' which prevents clearing notes (empty string treated as falsy). Reference: /app/backend/server.py:355

action_items: Optional: fix passlib bcrypt warning by pinning bcrypt<4 or updating passlib (warning only, login works).
Optional: make /api/register-push always graceful (catch HTTPException 500 from placeholder key and return {status: failed}) so mobile registration never surfaces a 500.
Optional: change 'if update_data.admin_notes' to 'is not None' to allow clearing notes.

server.py - All routes properly under /api prefix. CORS configured. No ObjectId leaked in responses (string conversion done).
